attempts.sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = 'src/click/core.py::Command' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.kind = 'method' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.name = c.name AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols m WHERE m.symbol_id = c.symbol_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = g.name)

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: This selects Group methods that share a name with a method defined directly in Command itself. The join on the same symbol_id ensures the Command method is a real definition in Command's body, not an inherited one.
sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = 'src/click/core.py::Command' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.kind = 'method' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.name = c.name AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols m WHERE m.symbol_id = c.symbol_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = g.name)
